verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee has no scraper marketplace in the evidence. It does ship first-party ready-made scrapers as dedicated APIs for Google SERP, Amazon search/product/pricing, Walmart search/product and YouTube search/metadata/subtitles, all usable without building extraction logic. These are a small fixed vendor catalog rather than a browsable marketplace. Missing for 10: a marketplace of ready-made scrapers (community or third-party), broad site coverage beyond the few dedicated APIs, and hands-on corroboration of the dedicated APIs.
